scope: Only design.png, first six tiles of keys/revisions/board-v1.png, selected source 16-frame sheet, and selected source six-key sheet where present. No builder notes, prior critiques, or tests inspected.
inspection_method: Actual view_image inspection of every listed image.
subject: flying-saucer
evidence: The asymmetric shallow rim, low irregular dome, dome/rim break and sparse surface marks remain recognizable in every key after the design is tilted nearly upright.
The keys maintain the source aeroshell-like near-edge-on attitude with the dome to the right and modest attitude/position variation, transferring that movement vocabulary onto the chosen doodle.
must_not_be_lost: The exact lopsided rim, uneven dome and small dome/rim gap.
The very sparse dash/speck surface marks and plain unfilled linework.
The upright banked pose family from the NASA CGI source without redesigning the doodle into a realistic aeroshell.
source_note: Reviewed as movement transfer from NASA CGI aeroshell imagery, not as a claim about physical UFO motion. The selected endpoint indices 13-14 precede the conspicuous trailing deployment in indices 15-16; no tether or parachute addition is required here.
